narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Any dot that opens wide will do, because a wide opening looks like a straight angle.
<bookmark mark='bent'/>Join eigh to a dot up on the left and look at it. The two arms bend at the vertex.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A straight angle has both arms on one line, so a bent shape is not a straight angle.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check each way, lay a ruler along the segment. See that it touches the new dot too.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>If the ruler touches both arms with no bend at the vertex, the angle is straight.
